web-snapper.name: Web Snapper
web-snapper.tagline: Save any web page, all of it, or just the parts you choose.
web-snapper.seoTitle: Web Snapper - Capture, annotate, and save web pages
web-snapper.seoDescription: Capture full web pages or selected sections, annotate what matters, and save clean local exports from your browser.
web-snapper.description: Capture full pages or selected regions and save them to local files. Highlight, annotate, and take notes right on the page, then keep everything organized.

highlights.title: Full or partial capture
highlights.desc: Grab an entire page or select exactly the content you want to keep.

highlights.title: Highlight & annotate
highlights.desc: Mark up pages with highlights, notes, and annotations as you read.

highlights.title: Save locally
highlights.desc: Export to local files so your captures are always yours.

privacyPoints: Runs only when you choose to capture
steps: Open the page you want to keep
Capture the whole page or choose a section
Annotate, export, and save it locally

deepDive.title: Capture exactly what matters
deepDive.desc: Save full pages for complete context or select a focused region when you only need one section.

deepDive.title: Add context before you save
deepDive.desc: Highlight important details, add notes, and keep the reason you saved a page attached to the capture.

deepDive.title: Keep portable records
deepDive.desc: Export captures into files you control, so useful web content stays available after the tab is gone.

faq.question: Can Web Snapper capture a full page?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for full-page capture as well as selected sections.

faq.question: Does Web Snapper upload captured pages?
faq.answer: No. The product is designed around local-first exports.

faq.question: Can I annotate captures?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow includes highlights, notes, and annotations.

ai-chat-snapper.name: AI Chat Snapper
ai-chat-snapper.tagline: Turn your AI conversations into documents you own.
ai-chat-snapper.seoTitle: AI Chat Snapper - Export ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and 7 more AI chats
ai-chat-snapper.seoDescription: Export conversations from 10 AI assistants - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and more - to PDF, Word, PNG, Markdown, TXT, or JSON. Save 100% offline, or send to Notion, Google Docs, and Obsidian.
ai-chat-snapper.description: Save chats from 10 AI assistants - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Doubao, and Perplexity - as PDF, Word, PNG, Markdown, TXT, or JSON. Keep everything 100% offline on your device, or send it to Notion, Google Docs, or Obsidian. Available in 10 languages.

highlights.title: Works with 10 AI assistants
highlights.desc: Export from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Doubao, and Perplexity.

highlights.title: Six export formats
highlights.desc: Save as PDF, Word, PNG image, Markdown, TXT, or JSON.

highlights.title: Save where you work
highlights.desc: Keep a local file, or send to Notion, Google Docs, or your Obsidian vault.

highlights.title: 100% offline option
highlights.desc: Local exports never leave your device - no account, no upload, fully private.

highlights.title: Available in 10 languages
highlights.desc: Use the extension in your language, with 10 interface languages built in.

highlights.title: Keep your history
highlights.desc: Never lose an important AI conversation again.

privacyPoints: Local exports stay 100% on your device
Works fully offline - no account or sign-in required
Optional Notion, Google Docs, and Obsidian exports only run when you choose
steps: Open a chat in any supported AI assistant
Choose a format - PDF, Word, PNG, Markdown, TXT, or JSON
Save locally or send it to Notion, Google Docs, or Obsidian

deepDive.title: Export readable documents
deepDive.desc: Turn long AI conversations into structured files that are easier to read, search, and share.

deepDive.title: Choose the right format
deepDive.desc: Save polished PDFs, editable Word files, PNG snapshots, clean Markdown, TXT, or JSON records.

deepDive.title: Save where you work
deepDive.desc: Keep exports as local files, or send them to Notion, Google Docs, or your local Obsidian vault.

faq.question: Which AI platforms are supported?
faq.answer: AI Chat Snapper works with 10 AI assistants: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Doubao, and Perplexity.

faq.question: Does it upload my conversations to your servers?
faq.answer: No. Exports are processed locally on your device, and the extension can run 100% offline. Optional Notion, Google Docs, and Obsidian exports go directly from your browser to the destination you choose.

faq.question: Which export formats and destinations can I use?
faq.answer: You can export to PDF, Word, PNG image, Markdown, TXT, and JSON, and save to a local file, Notion, Google Docs, or Obsidian.

faq.question: Is the extension available in my language?
faq.answer: AI Chat Snapper ships with 10 interface languages, so you can use it in your preferred language.

faq.question: Where can I read the privacy policy?
faq.answer: The AI Chat Snapper privacy policy is available from this product page and the site privacy page.

highlights.title: Collect reviews
highlights.desc: Gather user reviews from supported shopping sites.

highlights.title: Summarize & compare

highlights.title: Decide faster
highlights.desc: Cut through the noise and buy with confidence.

privacyPoints: Reads reviews only when you ask it to
steps: Summarize sentiment and compare key themes

deepDive.title: Collect the useful signal
deepDive.desc: Gather visible customer reviews from product pages so you can work from one organized view.

deepDive.title: Summarize common patterns
deepDive.desc: See repeated praise, complaints, tradeoffs, and sentiment without reading every review manually.

deepDive.title: Compare before you buy
deepDive.desc: Use review themes to compare products side by side and make faster decisions.

faq.question: Is Review Snapper available now?
faq.answer: Review Snapper is coming soon. You can join the waitlist for updates.

faq.question: What does it summarize?

faq.question: Can it compare products?
faq.answer: Product comparison is part of the planned workflow.
